data.name: FrighTV Presents GHOSTS
data.detailed_description:
You are the producer of GHOSTS, a once-popular supernatural TV show now resurrected on FrighTV for one terrifying night. What should have been a routine ghost-hunting broadcast quickly spirals into a nightmare as you realize the danger is real — and you are the only one who can save the cast.

Explore the control room and surrounding environments in first-person, piecing together what’s happening as the show’s feed comes in. View live-action footage on monitors, edit what goes on air, and coordinate responses in real time as the on-screen team investigates haunted locations. The urban legend of The Long Lady looms over every decision — one wrong move could cost the lives of your hosts.

Featuring full-motion video sequences, a talented cast from the hit film HOST directed by Jed Shepherd, creature designs by Trevor Henderson (Siren Head), and practical effects from Jim Henson’s Creature Shop, GHOSTS blends tense first-person gameplay, real-time decision making, and live-action storytelling into a single, unforgettable horror experience.

Key Features

  • First-Person Horror Adventure: Explore, investigate, and interact with the world around you in real time.

  • Live-Action Integration: View FMV sequences through monitors that advance the story and raise the stakes.

  • Legend of The Long Lady: Confront the terrifying urban myth that stalks both cast and player alike.
